content: Nkpábi awíe, mlɩpʋ tɔ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́, igyi ɔnɔkwalɩ kpa mlɩ nkpábi, tsúfɛ́ mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩbʋ Owíe ɔsʋ́sʋ́.
Mlɩkɩta mpaɩbɔ́tɔ́. Mlɩdɩnka ansɩ́ ɩwɩsʋ, ɩpánda ɛ́ itsia mlɩ klʋntɔ.
Mlɩbɔ mpáɩ ha anɩ ɛ́. Bulu ofínki ɔkpa ha anɩ atalɩ da Kristo ɩwɩ asʋn ŋaínhɛ́ amʋ ɔkan. Mʋ́ sʋ nda obu nɩ́.
Mlɩbɔ mpáɩ mlɩaa, ndáa mʋ́ ɔkan wankláán, alɩá ilehián.
Mlɩkɩ mlɩ nátɩtɔ ɔmátɔ́fɔtɔ. Nɩ́ ɔkpa ifínkí há mlɩ á, mlɩmáyintá mʋ́.
Mlɩ ɩtɔ́ɩ ɩwa anulɛ́, ɩwa labi, mɛ́nɩ mlɛ́talɩ́ lɛ́ ɔhagyíɔha asʋn fɩtɛ́hɛ́ ɔnɔ́ wankláán.
Anɩa opíó ɔdwɛpʋ́ Tihiko dɛ́ anɩ Wíe agyʋ́má yɔ. Osúmpʋ́ ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ ogyi. Ɔbɛ́bláa mlɩ alɩá mɩ́ ɩwɩ gyí fɛ́ɛ́.
Nawá mʋ mlɩ wá mbɛ́ɛ, ɔbɛ́bláa mlɩ alɩá anɩ ɩwɩ gyí, ɔwa mlɩ atɛtɔ-ɔnlɩn.
Mʋa anɩ píó ɔdwɛpʋ́ ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ Onesimo, ogyi mlɩ pɩ amʋ ɔbɛ́ba bɛbla mlɩ asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɩlaba nfɩ fɛ́ɛ́.

Aristarko, mɩ́ bá ánɩ́ mɩ́a mʋnyɔ anɩda obu ɔhá mlɩ itsiá. Alɩ kɛ́n Marko, ogyi Barnaba mʋ pio ámʋ ɛ́ ɔhá mlɩ itsiá nɩ́. Mlɩhɔ Marko ɔfɔɔ́ wankláán, nɩ́ ɔlɔtsʋn ba mlɩ wá fɛ́ alɩá nɛbláa mlɩ yáɩ́.
Opíó Yesu, bʋtɛtráa tɩ mʋ Yusto ɛ́ ɔhá mlɩ itsiá. Ahá abasá ánfɩ pɛ́ gyí Yudafɔá mɩ́a amʋ́nyɔ anɩdɛ́ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɩwɩ agyʋ́má yɔ nɩ́. Amʋ́ tɛ́kɩ́tá klʋn wá mɩ́ ɩwɩtɔ nɩ́.
Epafra, otsú mlɩ wá, ogyi Kristo Yesu osúmbi amʋ ɛ́ ɔhá mlɩ itsiá. Ɔtɛhɩ́ɛ́ bɔ mpáɩ há mlɩ ánɩ́ Bulu ɔwáa mlɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́n, ɔha amlɩfʋn, amlɩtalɩ bwɛ Bulu apɛ́ kugyíkʋ.
Nɛ́talɩ́ gyí mʋ ɩwɩ adánsɩɛ ánɩ́ ɔhɩ́ɛ́ ɔdɛ agyʋ́má yɔ mlɩa Akristofɔá bʋbʋ Laodikea pʋ́ Hierapoli ɩdátɔ́.
Anɩ ɔdwɛpʋ́ Luka, ogyi ɩlɔ ɔtsapʋ́ mʋa Dema bɛhá mlɩ itsiá.
Nɛhá anɩ apíó Laodikeafɔ ámʋ itsiá. Nɛhá Nunfa mʋa ɔpasua ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ mʋ wóyítɔ́ amʋ ɛ́ itsiá.
Nɩ́ mlɛkla ɔwʋlʋ́ ánfɩ súná ɔpasua ámʋ tá á, mlɩpʋsɩsɩ Laodikeafɔ ɛ́. Mlɩkla amʋ́ klɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ nɔpʋsɩ́sɩ́ amʋ́ ámʋ ɛ́.
Mlɩbla Arkipo mlɩaa, ɔmɔ́ɔ agyʋ́má ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lɔ́pʋwá mʋ ɩbɩtɔ ámʋ ɔnɔ́ wankláán.
Mɩ́ Paulo, onutónutó lawá ɩbɩ ɔwʋlʋ́ ánfɩ asɩ. Mlɩmátan ánɩ́ nda obu. Bulu ogyíi mlɩ bʋalɛ.
